section_title: Money Laundering Risks in Financial Services > Control and ownership for AML compliance

propositions.proposition: 当审查所有权结构时，监管义务要求识别客户的 UBO
source_quotes: regulatory obligation to identify the UBO of a customer

propositions.proposition: 为反洗钱目的，多数司法管辖区要求识别持股 25% 或以上的受益所有人
source_quotes: require beneficial ownership to be identified at a threshold of 25% or more

propositions.proposition: 机构应采用风险为本的方法设定适当的受益所有权阈值
source_quotes: Your organization will set the appropriate threshold using a riskbased approach

propositions.proposition: 对于某些高风险客户，受益所有权阈值可低至 10%，对于风险特别高的客户可低至 5%（例如高风险司法管辖区的代理行关系可能将阈值设为 5%）
source_quotes: beneficial ownership threshold might be as low as 10%

propositions.proposition: 在识别 UBO 时，需要计算直接和间接持股的总和；如果总和达到规定的受益所有权阈值（如 25%），该人为 UBO，否则不是。例如个人 D 持有 82% 成为 UBO，而个人 C 持有 18% 则不是
source_quotes: need to identify indirect ownership stakes in addition to direct ownership
Individual D ... is then considered a UBO with 82%
Individual C ... is not a UBO

propositions.proposition: 当公司没有自然人受益所有人时，应识别并核实控制人或名义受益所有人
source_quotes: In companies where there is no natural beneficial owner, a controller or a notional beneficial owner should be identified and verified

propositions.proposition: 对于上市公司，名义受益所有人可以是总裁或首席执行官
source_quotes: a notional beneficial owner could be the president or chief executive officer
